title: WaterSound Crossings B-107 - 100 S Bridge Lane
h1: WaterSound Crossings B-107 - 100 S Bridge Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Spectacular Gulf views- Fantastic porch spaces- Dedicated office space- Pool and beach are just yards away- 3 Adult Bikes- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella)- Private deeded beach access- Free WiFi- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout *This property come with 2 designated parking spaces, with 1 designated parking space and 1 in the garage. This condo permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.*Beginning in March 2025 and continuing through 2026, the WaterSound Crossings condominiums will undergo an extensive exterior refurbishment project. During this period, residents and guests should expect significant construction activity, including the boarding of windows and restricted access to balconies in affected buildings. These measures are necessary to ensure safety and facilitate the successful completion of the work.DETAILS: The view is like no other: Beyond the sea oats and sand dunes lie the aquamarine waters of the Gulf. This 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom retreat at the Crossings in WaterSound is but a short walk to the beach - or the pool, depending on your mood. Take your morning coffee out to the balcony to start your day, then head down to the beach for an afternoon you'll never forget. Afterward, gather with family and friends in the gourmet kitchen and settle in for vacation movie night before the flat-screen television in the living room. The kitchen features black granite countertops, designer cabinets, and select stainless steel appliances, including a gas range. Incredibly, the kitchen offers its own stunning Gulf view. The dining area offers seating for 5, with seating for another 3 at the counter. Near-floor-to-ceiling windows allow for plenty of natural light. Hardwood floors run throughout the living room with its comfy seating and vast flat-screen television. Easy access to the balcony allows for evenings spent with sundowners on the balcony overlooking the Gulf. Natural teak furniture completes the outdoor feel. The first floor features a primary bedroom with a king bed, flat-screen television, and a private bathroom with a double vanity, jetted tub and shower. Adjacent to the primary bedroom is an area with two twin bunk beds - perfect for the young and the young at heart alike. The second floor has a guest bedroom offering a queen bed, flat-screen television and a private bathroom with a shower only. A second guest bedroom has two twin beds and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. The living room has a twin sleeper sofa. A dedicated office space makes for a peaceful retreat for who need to get a little work done during vacation. This condo sleeps 8.While the natural setting of WaterSound defines this coastal getaway, the amenities truly set it apart. Enjoy the four community pools. Afterward, take a bike ride down to Seacrest or to Alys Beach. Book this coastal gem today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Bunk Area: Twin BunkSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Two Twins, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Living Area: Twin Sleeper Sofa*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
